Title: Public preview: Custom node config for Windows

Body.Content:
This feature allows you to modify predefined settings on Windows nodepools including imageGcHighThreshold, imageGcLowThreshold, containerLogMaxSizeMB and containerLogMaxFiles.

To learn more, visit: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/aks/custom-node-configuration
